Overview

Guarulhos is a city in SP with a population of 1,392,121. São Paulo’s largest suburb and home to Brazil’s busiest international airport, a major industrial and logistics center. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
